items.title: 33.7 Pani ke wasail ki hifazat aur bachat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of protection and conservation of water (PDF 258).

blocks.text: Pani ke wasail do bare tareeqon se mehfooz aur mehfooz-tar rakhe ja sakte hain: aaloodgi qaboo kar ke taake nuqsan-deh maddey aabi zakhiron mein na jayein (33.7.1), aur pani ko kifayat se use kar ke taake kam zaya ho (33.7.2).

blocks.prompt: Pani ke wasail ki hifazat ke do bare tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aaloodgi qaboo karna aur pani kifayat se use karna (bachat).

items: Pani ki hifazat: aaloodgi par qaboo aur kifayati istemal.
